acquirer.name: AG Twin Brook Capital Income Fund

listed_quote.quote: AGTB is an affiliated, privately offered business development company (“BDC”) managed by AG Twin Brook Manager, LLC (“AGTB Adviser”), an affiliate of Angelo, Gordon & Co., L.P. (“Angelo Gordon”). TCAP is a publicly offered, non-exchange traded BDC managed by AGTB Fund Manager, LLC (“TCAP Adviser”), an affiliate of Angelo Gordon, with substantially the same investment objective as AGTB.

announcement.quote: On May 19, 2023, AG Twin Brook Capital Income Fund, a Delaware statutory trust (“TCAP”), entered into an Agreement and Plan of Merger (“Merger Agreement”) with AG Twin Brook BDC, Inc., a Delaware corporation (“AGTB”).

outcome_evidence.quote: On July 28, 2023, AG Twin Brook Capital Income Fund, a Delaware statutory trust (the “Fund”), completed its previously announced acquisition of AG Twin Brook BDC, Inc., a Delaware corporation (“AGTB” and, together with the Fund, the “Parties”), with the Fund continuing as the surviving company (the “Transaction”).

deals.notes: Outcome is not_a_listed_pair because the acquirer is a non-exchange traded BDC and the target a privately offered BDC. For information, the merger was completed on 2023-07-28 per the cited 8-K (Item 2.01). The 2023-05-17 and 2023-05-19 8-K and DEFA14A filings otherwise concern TPG's acquisition of Angelo Gordon (the adviser's parent), not a fund merger; the proxy statements of 2023-07-21 onward concern the adviser transaction.
